# Asahi Shimbun (朝日新聞)

> > Japan's leading national newspaper covering breaking news, politics, international affairs, legal cases, and social issues with comprehensive reporting from Tokyo and correspondents worldwide.

The Asahi Shimbun provides in-depth coverage of Japanese domestic politics, international relations with focus on US-Iran-Israel tensions, court proceedings, and social policy. Major coverage includes the Takaichi administration, Middle East conflicts, legal reforms, and economic developments affecting Japan.

## Key Topics

- Middle East Crisis (Iran-Israel-US tensions)
- Japanese Politics & Diet proceedings
- Court rulings & criminal trials
- Federal Reserve (FRB) & monetary policy
- Tokyo District Court cases
- Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae
- Liberal Democratic Party (自民党)
- US-Japan military cooperation
- Trade & rare earth resources
- Legal reform & prosecution
- Minamata disease recognition
- Political fundraising controversies
- Employment law violations
- Budget deliberations
